passages.text: At that time all the people gathered together in the square before the Water Gate, and they asked Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.
passages.sermon:
All the people gathered together.
They gathered as one group.
They met in the square in front of the Water Gate.
Ezra was a scribe.
The people spoke to Ezra the scribe.
They asked Ezra to bring the Book of the Law of Moses.
The LORD had commanded this Law for Israel.
passages.original: וַיֵּאָסְפ֤וּ כָל־ הָעָם֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֔ד אֶל־ הָ֣רְח֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר־ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ לְעֶזְרָ֣א הַסֹּפֵ֔ר לְהָבִ֗יא אֶת־ סֵ֙פֶר֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly of men and women and all who could listen and understand.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest.
Ezra brought the Law of God.
Ezra brought the Law to the people.
He brought it before the whole assembly.
Men were there.
Women were there.
Everyone who could listen and understand was there.
This happened on the first day of the seventh month.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֣יא עֶזְרָ֣א הַ֠כֹּהֵן אֶֽת־ הַתּוֹרָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֤י הַקָּהָל֙ מֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֔ה וְכֹ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין לִשְׁמֹ֑עַ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

passages.text: So Ezra read it aloud from daybreak until noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate, in front of the men and women and those who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a scribe.
Ezra stood before the people.
He stood in the square in front of the Water Gate.
He read the Book of the Law aloud.
He began reading at daybreak.
He continued reading until noon.
Men were present.
Women were present.
Everyone who could understand was present.
All the people listened carefully to the Book of the Law.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָא־ בוֹ֩ לִפְנֵ֨י הָרְח֜וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ לִפְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר־ הַמַּ֗יִם מִן־ הָאוֹר֙ עַד־ מַחֲצִ֣ית הַיּ֔וֹם נֶ֛גֶד הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַמְּבִינִ֑ים וְאָזְנֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ סֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: Ezra the scribe stood on a high wooden platform built for this occasion. At his right side stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, and at his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash-baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a scribe.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform.
People built this platform for this occasion.
Six men stood at Ezra’s right side.
Their names were Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah.
Seven men stood at Ezra’s left side.
Their names were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash-baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֞ד עֶזְרָ֣א הַסֹּפֵ֗ר עַֽל־ מִגְדַּל־ עֵץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ לַדָּבָר֒ וַיַּֽעֲמֹ֣ד אֶצְל֡וֹ מַתִּתְיָ֡ה וְשֶׁ֡מַע וַ֠עֲנָיָה וְאוּרִיָּ֧ה וְחִלְקִיָּ֛ה וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה עַל־ יְמִינ֑וֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאל֗וֹ פְּ֠דָיָה וּמִֽישָׁאֵ֧ל וּמַלְכִּיָּ֛ה וְחָשֻׁ֥ם וְחַשְׁבַּדָּ֖נָה זְכַרְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּֽם׃פ

passages.text: Ezra opened the book in full view of all the people, since he was standing above them all, and as he opened it, all the people stood up.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a scribe and a leader of the people.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform.
All the people could see Ezra.
Ezra opened the book.
Everyone saw Ezra open the book.
Ezra stood above all the people.
All the people stood up when Ezra opened the book.
passages.original: וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח עֶזְרָ֤א הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ לְעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־ מֵעַ֥ל כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם הָיָ֑ה וּכְפִתְח֖וֹ עָֽמְד֥וּ כָל־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God, and with their hands uplifted, all the people said, “Amen, Amen!” Then they bowed down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and a scribe.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform above the people.
Ezra blessed the LORD.
The LORD is the great God.
All the people lifted their hands.
All the people said, “Amen, Amen!”
All the people bowed down.
All the people worshiped the LORD.
They put their faces to the ground.
passages.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ עֶזְרָ֔א אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים הַגָּד֑וֹל וַיַּֽעֲנ֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֜ם אָמֵ֤ן׀ אָמֵן֙ בְּמֹ֣עַל יְדֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְּד֧וּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֻּ֛ לַיהוָ֖ה אַפַּ֥יִם אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah—instructed the people in the Law as they stood in their places.
passages.sermon: The Levites taught the people the Law of God.\r\nThe Levites included Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah.\r\nThe people stood in their places.
passages.original: וְיֵשׁ֡וּעַ וּבָנִ֡י וְשֵׁרֵ֥בְיָ֣ה׀ יָמִ֡ין עַקּ֡וּב שַׁבְּתַ֣י׀ הֽוֹדִיָּ֡ה מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה קְלִיטָ֣א עֲזַרְיָה֩ יוֹזָבָ֨ד חָנָ֤ן פְּלָאיָה֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מְבִינִ֥ים אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם לַתּוֹרָ֑ה וְהָעָ֖ם עַל־ עָמְדָֽם׃

passages.text: So they read from the Book of the Law of God, explaining it and giving insight, so that the people could understand what was being read.
passages.sermon:
The Levites read from the Book of the Law of God.
They explained the words clearly.
They gave understanding to the people.
The people understood what was read.
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְא֥וּ בַסֵּ֛פֶר בְּתוֹרַ֥ת הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מְפֹרָ֑שׁ וְשׂ֣וֹם שֶׂ֔כֶל וַיָּבִ֖ינוּ בַּמִּקְרָֽא׃ס

passages.text: Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to all of them, “This day is holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep.” For all the people were weeping as they heard the words of the Law.
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah was the governor.
Ezra was the priest and scribe.
The Levites were instructing the people.
Nehemiah, Ezra, and the Levites spoke to all the people.
They said, “This day is holy to the LORD your God.”
They said, “Do not mourn.”
They said, “Do not weep.”
All the people were weeping.
They wept as they heard the words of the Law.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נְחֶמְיָ֣ה ה֣וּא הַתִּרְשָׁ֡תָא וְעֶזְרָ֣א הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ הַסֹּפֵ֡ר וְהַלְוִיִּם֩ הַמְּבִינִ֨ים אֶת־ הָעָ֜ם לְכָל־ הָעָ֗ם הַיּ֤וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ־ הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם אַל־ תִּֽתְאַבְּל֖וּ וְאַל־ תִּבְכּ֑וּ כִּ֤י בוֹכִים֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם כְּשָׁמְעָ֖ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah was the governor of the people.
He spoke to the people.
He said, “Go now.
Eat rich food.
Drink sweet drinks.
Send portions to those who have nothing prepared.
Today is holy to our Lord.
Do not be sad.
The joy of the LORD is your strength.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֡ם לְכוּ֩ אִכְל֨וּ מַשְׁמַנִּ֜ים וּשְׁת֣וּ מַֽמְתַקִּ֗ים וְשִׁלְח֤וּ מָנוֹת֙ לְאֵ֣ין נָכ֣וֹן ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־ קָד֥וֹשׁ הַיּ֖וֹם לַאֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ וְאַל־ תֵּ֣עָצֵ֔בוּ כִּֽי־ חֶדְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא מָֽעֻזְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Be still, since today is holy. Do not grieve.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites spoke to all the people.
The Levites told the people to be calm.
The Levites said, "Be still."
The Levites said, "Today is holy."
The Levites said, "Do not grieve."
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם מַחְשִׁ֤ים לְכָל־ הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֣ר הַ֔סּוּ כִּ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ וְאַל־ תֵּעָצֵֽבוּ׃

passages.text: Then all the people began to eat and drink, to send out portions, and to rejoice greatly, because they understood the words that had been made known to them.
passages.sermon:
All the people listened to the leaders.
The leaders explained God’s words to them.
The people understood what God wanted.
The people began to eat.
The people began to drink.
The people sent food to others.
The people rejoiced greatly.
They were joyful because they understood the words given to them.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכ֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֜ם לֶאֱכֹ֤ל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת֙ וּלְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָנ֔וֹת וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֵבִ֙ינוּ֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹדִ֖יעוּ לָהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and Levites, gathered around Ezra the scribe to study the words of the Law.
passages.sermon:
On the second day of the month, the leaders of the families gathered together.
The priests and the Levites joined them.
They all came to Ezra.
Ezra was the scribe.
They wanted to study the words of the Law.
They wanted to understand what the Law said.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֡י נֶאֶסְפוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת לְכָל־ הָעָ֗ם הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־ עֶזְרָ֖א הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: And they found written in the Law, which the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month.
passages.sermon:
The Law is the teaching God gave to Israel.
God gave this Law through Moses.
The leaders, priests, and Levites studied the Law with Ezra the scribe.
They found a command written in the Law.
God commanded the Israelites to live in booths.
They must do this during the feast in the seventh month.
passages.original: וַֽיִּמְצְא֖וּ כָּת֣וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ יֵשְׁב֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל בַּסֻּכּ֛וֹת בֶּחָ֖ג בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

passages.text: So they proclaimed this message and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.”
passages.sermon:
The leaders, priests, and Levites gathered with Ezra the scribe.
They studied the words of the Law.
They found a command in the Law of God.
God gave this command through Moses.
The command said the Israelites must live in booths during the feast of the seventh month.
The leaders announced this command to all the people.
They spread the message in every town and in Jerusalem.
They said, “Go out to the hill country.
Bring back branches of olive trees.
Bring branches of wild olive trees.
Bring branches of myrtle trees.
Bring branches of palm trees.
Bring branches of other leafy trees.
Use these branches to make booths.
Do this as it is written in the Law.”
passages.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ וְיַעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בְּכָל־ עָרֵיהֶם֮ וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ צְא֣וּ הָהָ֗ר וְהָבִ֙יאוּ֙ עֲלֵי־ זַ֙יִת֙ וַעֲלֵי־ עֵ֣ץ שֶׁ֔מֶן וַעֲלֵ֤י הֲדַס֙ וַעֲלֵ֣י תְמָרִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֖י עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֑ת לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת סֻכֹּ֖ת כַּכָּתֽוּב׃פ

passages.text: And the people went out, brought back branches, and made booths on their own rooftops, in their courtyards, in the court of the house of God, and in the squares by the Water Gate and by the Gate of Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel had returned from exile.
They heard the Law of God read to them.
They learned that God commanded them to live in booths during the feast of the seventh month.
The people went out from their homes.
They gathered branches from trees.
They made booths for themselves.
Each person built a booth on his own rooftop.
They also built booths in their courtyards.
They built booths in the courtyards of the house of God.
They built booths in the square by the Water Gate.
They built booths in the square by the Gate of Ephraim.
passages.original: וַיֵּצְא֣וּ הָעָם֮ וַיָּבִיאוּ֒ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ֩ לָהֶ֨ם סֻכּ֜וֹת אִ֤ישׁ עַל־ גַּגּוֹ֙ וּבְחַצְרֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְחַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבִרְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַמַּ֔יִם וּבִרְח֖וֹב שַׁ֥עַר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The whole assembly who had returned from exile made booths and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated like this. And there was great rejoicing.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites had returned from exile.
All the people gathered together.
They made booths.
They lived in the booths.
The Israelites had not done this since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
No one had celebrated like this until that day.
There was very great rejoicing.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֣וּ כָֽל־ הַ֠קָּהָל הַשָּׁבִ֨ים מִן־ הַשְּׁבִ֥י׀ סֻכּוֹת֮ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ בַסֻּכּוֹת֒ כִּ֣י לֹֽא־ עָשׂ֡וּ מִימֵי֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בִּן־ נ֥וּן כֵּן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַתְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. The Israelites kept the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day they held an assembly, according to the ordinance.
passages.sermon:
Ezra was a priest and scribe.
Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God.
He read every day.
He started on the first day of the feast.
He continued until the last day of the feast.
The Israelites kept the feast for seven days.
On the eighth day, the Israelites held an assembly.
They did this as the law commanded.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּקְרָא בְּסֵ֨פֶר תּוֹרַ֤ת הָאֱלֹהִים֙ י֣וֹם׀ בְּי֔וֹם מִן־ הַיּוֹם֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הָאַחֲר֑וֹן וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ חָג֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י עֲצֶ֖רֶת כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃פ
